bugs.name: Watching repo search treats % and _ as SQL LIKE wildcards instead of literal text
bugs.summary: The search lists all three watched repositories (agent13-alpha-notes, agent13-zulu-book, harbor-handbook) even though none of their names or descriptions contain "%". The same happens with a single underscore "_": all repositories are listed. The search treats SQL LIKE wildcards % and _ as match-anything instead of literal text. (on /notifications/watching)
bugs.expected: No repository matches the literal text "%", so the list should show the empty state 'No matching results found.', as it does for a normal non-matching word such as zzz.
bugs.actual: The search lists all three watched repositories (agent13-alpha-notes, agent13-zulu-book, harbor-handbook) even though none of their names or descriptions contain "%". The same happens with a single underscore "_": all repositories are listed. The search treats SQL LIKE wildcards % and _ as match-anything instead of literal text.
reproSteps: Open https://5503-iqgs3fdkdmn70ntvor14g.e2b.app/notifications/watching while signed in as eval (the Watching list shows harbor-handbook, agent13-zulu-book and agent13-alpha-notes).
Click the 'Search repos...' box and type a single percent sign: %
Click the magnifier button 'Search...' (or press Enter).

bugs.name: Notification list order does not follow the times shown on the rows
bugs.summary: The Read list is not in newest-first order: 'eval/harbor-handbook #9 agent4-maya-notif check' (2 minutes ago) is listed below 'eval/harbor-handbook #8 agent3-notif-alpha' and 'eval/harbor-handbook #7 agent4-notif-two check' (both 6 minutes ago), and '#1' (2 minutes ago) sits below the 6-minute-old '#8'. Both rows involved carry no pin, so pinning does not explain it. The exact stored times are #8 15:03:52, #1 15:07:31, #7 15:03:25, #9 15:07:06, #6 15:03:13 — not descending. The Unread list of the same account is strictly newest-first, so the two lists disagree. (on /notifications?q=read)
bugs.expected: Rows are listed newest first, as in the Unread view, so the row at the top is the most recent event.
bugs.actual: The Read list is not in newest-first order: 'eval/harbor-handbook #9 agent4-maya-notif check' (2 minutes ago) is listed below 'eval/harbor-handbook #8 agent3-notif-alpha' and 'eval/harbor-handbook #7 agent4-notif-two check' (both 6 minutes ago), and '#1' (2 minutes ago) sits below the 6-minute-old '#8'. Both rows involved carry no pin, so pinning does not explain it. The exact stored times are #8 15:03:52, #1 15:07:31, #7 15:03:25, #9 15:07:06, #6 15:03:13 — not descending. The Unread list of the same account is strictly newest-first, so the two lists disagree.
reproSteps: Read the relative times on the right of the rows from top to bottom: 5 minutes ago, 1 minute ago, 6 minutes ago, 2 minutes ago, 6 minutes ago.

Note that the rows showing '2 minutes ago' ('eval/harbor-handbook #9 agent4-maya-notif check' and '#1 Expand the onboarding checklist') come below rows showing '6 minutes ago' ('#8 agent3-notif-alpha', '#7 agent4-notif-two check'), and that #7 and #9 carry no pin icon.
Reload the page: the same order comes back.

bugs.name: Watching search form keeps stale control state after browser Back (filter radios, search text) and re-submits it
bugs.summary: After Back the address is ?q=harbor&sort=recentupdate and the unfiltered result is listed, but the Filter menu still shows the "Private" radio selected. Choosing "Not Archived" then sends ?q=harbor&archived=0&private=1&sort=recentupdate and the page shows "No matching results found." even though eval/harbor-handbook is not archived and matches "harbor". The stale filter left behind by Back is silently re-applied, so a filter the person never chose this time changes the result. (on /notifications/watching)
bugs.expected: After Back the Filter control should match the address (no filter), and choosing "Not Archived" should send ?q=harbor&archived=0 and list eval/harbor-handbook.
bugs.actual: After Back the address is ?q=harbor&sort=recentupdate and the unfiltered result is listed, but the Filter menu still shows the "Private" radio selected. Choosing "Not Archived" then sends ?q=harbor&archived=0&private=1&sort=recentupdate and the page shows "No matching results found." even though eval/harbor-handbook is not archived and matches "harbor". The stale filter left behind by Back is silently re-applied, so a filter the person never chose this time changes the result.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iqgs3fdkdmn70ntvor14g.e2b.app/notifications/watching
Type harbor in 'Search repos...' and press Enter (address becomes ?q=harbor&sort=recentupdate, eval/harbor-handbook is listed)
Open the Filter menu and choose Private (address becomes ?q=harbor&private=1..., list says 'No matching results found.')
Press the browser Back button (address returns to ?q=harbor&sort=recentupdate and eval/harbor-handbook is listed again)
Open the Filter menu: the 'Private' radio is still selected even though the address has no private parameter and the list is unfiltered
Choose 'Not Archived': the address becomes ?q=harbor&archived=0&private=1&sort=recentupdate and the page shows 'No matching results found.'

bugs.name: Back to the notification list after opening a notification shows the old unread row and count
bugs.summary: The list comes back with the earlier state: the Unread tab still shows the old count and the notification just opened is still listed as unread (screenshot: \"Unread 1\" with eval/harbor-handbook #14 still in the list, after that row had been opened and marked read). Reloading the page corrects it (#14 disappears, count drops). Seen twice: with #15 (Unread stayed 2) and with #14 (Unread stayed 1). (on /notifications)
bugs.expected: The notification list comes back with the current state: the notification that was just opened is no longer in the Unread list and the Unread count / bell badge match it (0 unread for that item).
bugs.actual: The list comes back with the earlier state: the Unread tab still shows the old count and the notification just opened is still listed as unread (screenshot: \"Unread 1\" with eval/harbor-handbook #14 still in the list, after that row had been opened and marked read). Reloading the page corrects it (#14 disappears, count drops). Seen twice: with #15 (Unread stayed 2) and with #14 (Unread stayed 1).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open /notifications with at least one unread notification (e.g. an issue opened in eval/harbor-handbook by another user).
Note the Unread tab count and the notification rows.
Click a notification row (e.g. eval/harbor-handbook #14 "agent2-round2-a"); the app opens the issue, and the navbar bell badge goes to 0, i.e. that notification is now read.
Press the browser Back button to return to /notifications.
